payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jeanene, Layla, Mona, Pauline, Sara, Shaunna

payload.content: Jeanene planning. Private costs suggest best fits: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.16, ISSUE-0001::review/docs 2.70, ISSUE-0001::test 3.78. Critical ISSUE-0002 tasks are expensive for me (review 7.72, test 10.81, implement 17.44). Tentative preference is a low-cost ISSUE-0001 micro-task, especially triage/review/docs, unless others have stronger claims. Please share intended picks to avoid duplicates.

Sara planning. My private costs: ISSUE-0002::review 9.00, ISSUE-0002::test 12.60, ISSUE-0002::implement 19.00; ISSUE-0001::triage 16.00, ISSUE-0001::review/docs 20.00, ISSUE-0001::test 28.00, ISSUE-0001::implement 40.00. Best option for me is ISSUE-0002::review; ISSUE-0002::test is second-best but notably worse. Given Jeanene's low costs on ISSUE-0001 subtasks, tentative plan is I target ISSUE-0002::review and Jeanene takes a cheap ISSUE-0001 task to avoid overlap and maximize completed tasks/priority. Please share intended picks. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Layla planning. My availability 4h; strongest skills testing 0.90 and mobile-development 0.77. Private costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 1.83, review/docs 2.29, test 3.21, implement 4.58; ISSUE-0002::review 7.24, test 11.74, implement 18.48. Best fit/cost is ISSUE-0001::triage, then ISSUE-0001::review/docs, then ISSUE-0001::test. ISSUE-0002 options are all much more expensive and some exceed availability. Tentative preference: claim ISSUE-0001::triage if available; fallback ISSUE-0001::review or docs. Please share if anyone has even lower cost on triage so we can spread across ISSUE-0001 tasks and keep Sara on ISSUE-0002::review.

Pauline planning. Availability 8h; strongest skill mobile-development 0.61. My private costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.25, review/docs 2.82, test 3.94, implement 5.63; ISSUE-0002::review 40, test 56, implement 80. So I am a strong fit only for ISSUE-0001 tasks, with best options triage then review/docs then test. Since Layla has slightly lower cost on triage (1.83) and Jeanene also slightly lower than me on triage/review/docs, I suggest preserving Sara for ISSUE-0002::review and spreading ISSUE-0001 among low-cost agents. My tentative preference order is ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::test to avoid collision on triage/review, but I can flex among any ISSUE-0001 subtask except if others have much better fit. Please share remaining agents' intended picks so we can cover distinct tasks. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Mona planning. Availability 7h; top skill testing 0.87. My private costs: ISSUE-0002::review 7.44, ISSUE-0002::test 10.42, ISSUE-0002::implement 15.89; ISSUE-0001::triage 16.00, review/docs 20.00, test 28.00, implement 40.00. So my clear best option is ISSUE-0002::review, with ISSUE-0002::test second-best; all ISSUE-0001 tasks are very expensive for me. Since Sara also prefers ISSUE-0002::review at cost 9.00, I seem to be the slightly better fit for that slot. Tentative proposal: Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test only if needed / if no better critical claimant exists, and Jeanene/Layla/Pauline cover distinct ISSUE-0001 subtasks. If someone else has a significantly cheaper feasible critical task, please say so; otherwise I will likely target ISSUE-0002::review in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Shaunna planning. Availability 10h; top skills mobile-development 0.87, ui-ux-design 0.74. My private costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 1.65, review/docs 2.06, test 2.88, implement 4.12; ISSUE-0002::review 8.53, test 11.94, implement 17.05. So I am strongest overall on ISSUE-0001 tasks, especially triage/review/docs/test, and only moderate on ISSUE-0002::review. Relative to current posts: I am cheapest reported so far on ISSUE-0001::triage and also slightly cheaper than others on ISSUE-0001::review/docs/test. Mona appears best for ISSUE-0002::review; Sara is next-best among reported critical options. Tentative coordination proposal to maximize distinct feasible claims: Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Layla->ISSUE-0001::triage or review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::review or docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::docs or test, and I can take whichever of ISSUE-0001::test / review / docs remains uncovered, with current personal preference for ISSUE-0001::test if triage/review/docs are already spoken for. If triage is still unclaimed in later iteration, I may take triage since I have the lowest known cost. Please share final lean so we can avoid collisions. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jeanene planning update after reading others: to maximize distinct feasible claims, I currently lean away from ISSUE-0002 since Mona/Sara have better fits there and my critical costs are high. Among ISSUE-0001 tasks, Layla/Shaunna are strongest on triage, Pauline is flexible on docs/test, and Shaunna can absorb whichever ISSUE-0001 slot remains. So my current lean is ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs, preferring whichever helps avoid collisions after others firm up. Coalition/publicly, a plausible low-conflict allocation looks like Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test or skip depending on whether second critical claim is worthwhile/feasible, Layla/Shaunna/Pauline/Jeanene spread across ISSUE-0001 triage/review/docs/test. I will avoid triage if a lower-cost agent wants it.

Sara planning update: after reading public costs, Mona is the best reported fit for ISSUE-0002::review (7.44), while my best remaining distinct critical option is ISSUE-0002::test at cost 12.60. To maximize completed tasks and avoid duplicate review claims, my current lean is Sara->ISSUE-0002::test if Mona commits to review; otherwise I can fallback to ISSUE-0002::review. For ISSUE-0001, Layla/Shaunna/Jeanene/Pauline seem able to cover triage/review/docs/test cheaply, so I will avoid ISSUE-0001 unless coordination changes. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Layla planning update: based on reported costs, a strong low-conflict allocation seems to be Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test, and ISSUE-0001 spread among Shaunna/Jeanene/Pauline/me. Since Shaunna is cheapest on triage (1.65) and I am still cheap on review/docs/test, I can shift off triage to reduce total cost overlap. My current lean for execution is ISSUE-0001::review, with fallback ISSUE-0001::docs if Jeanene prefers review. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 and likely avoid triage unless coordination changes.

Pauline planning update: given current posts, a low-conflict high-coverage allocation looks like Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test, Layla->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, and Pauline->ISSUE-0001::test. This uses 6 distinct feasible tasks, keeps critical work covered by the best available fits, and places me on my best remaining distinct ISSUE-0001 slot (test cost 3.94) after triage/review/docs are tentatively spoken for by slightly cheaper agents. My current execution lean is ISSUE-0001::test, with fallback to ISSUE-0001::docs only if Jeanene or others move off their current lean. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Mona planning update: current low-conflict allocation proposed on board looks good to me: Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Layla->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::test. This gives 6 distinct feasible tasks and matches my private costs well. Unless anyone objects or reveals a cheaper feasible critical-review claimant, I intend to keep leaning ISSUE-0002::review in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Shaunna planning update: I support the emerging 6-task allocation as currently lowest-conflict and cost-efficient from reported data: Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Layla->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::test. My private cost on ISSUE-0001::triage is 1.65, which is the lowest reported, so I am happy to anchor triage there and avoid competing for review/docs/test. Unless someone signals a change, my execution lean is ISSUE-0001::triage. Fallback order if collisions arise: ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::review, but primary lean remains triage. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jeanene planning confirmation: I support the emerging 6-task allocation as low-conflict and cost-efficient from reported data: Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Layla->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::test. My current execution lean is ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 2.70), with fallback ISSUE-0001::review only if Layla moves. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 and likely avoid triage given lower-cost claimants there. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Sara planning confirmation: I support the converged 6-task allocation as currently lowest-conflict and high-coverage from reported costs: Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Layla->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::test. My execution lean remains ISSUE-0002::test (cost 12.60), with fallback to ISSUE-0002::review only if Mona moves off review. I will avoid ISSUE-0001 unless coordination changes. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Layla planning confirmation: I support the converged 6-task allocation as low-conflict and cost-efficient: Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Layla->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::test. My execution lean remains ISSUE-0001::review (cost 2.29), with fallback ISSUE-0001::docs only if Jeanene moves. I will avoid triage since Shaunna is cheapest there and avoid ISSUE-0002 due to much higher cost / weaker feasibility. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Pauline planning confirmation: I continue to support the converged 6-task allocation as best-known low-conflict, high-coverage plan from reported costs: Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Layla->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::test. My execution lean remains ISSUE-0001::test (cost 3.94), with fallback ISSUE-0001::docs only if Jeanene moves off docs or collision risk appears. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 due to extremely high cost and avoid triage/review since lower-cost claimants are already aligned there. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Mona planning final for iter 1: I support the converged allocation and will keep my execution lean as ISSUE-0002::review (cost 7.44, feasible within 7h availability). This preserves distinct coverage with Sara on ISSUE-0002::test and the others on ISSUE-0001 triage/review/docs/test. Fallback only if collision/change: ISSUE-0002::test, but primary remains ISSUE-0002::review.

Shaunna planning final for iter 1: no objection to the converged 6-task allocation. My execution intent remains ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.65, lowest known reported cost there, feasible within 10h). Fallback only if unexpected collision/change: ISSUE-0001::docs, then ISSUE-0001::review. Proposed final slate remains Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Layla->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::test. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jeanene planning final update: no new objections from me. I remain aligned with the converged 6-task slate and intend to keep ISSUE-0001::docs as my execution lean (cost 2.70, feasible within 6h), with fallback ISSUE-0001::review only if Layla unexpectedly moves off review. This should preserve 6 distinct feasible claims with minimal collision risk.

Sara planning final check-in: no new objections from me. I remain aligned with the converged 6-task slate and currently intend ISSUE-0002::test (cost 12.60, feasible within 7h) assuming Mona keeps ISSUE-0002::review. Fallback remains ISSUE-0002::review only if Mona unexpectedly moves off review. I will avoid ISSUE-0001 unless coordination changes.

Fallback ISSUE-0001::docs only if Jeanene moves off docs or collision risk appears unexpectedly. I will avoid triage since Shaunna is cheapest there and avoid ISSUE-0002 due to much higher cost / weaker feasibility. (phase=planning, iter=1)

No changes from my side; fallback only to ISSUE-0002::test if something unexpected changes with Sara/review. Proposed final slate remains Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Layla->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::test.
